features.name: Unlock VPN Plus
features.description: Spoofs the highest plan tier for all UI unlocks, while routing connections through free servers for server-side compatibility. Also skips the upgrade onboarding dialog after login.

features.name: Remove delay
features.description: Removes the imposed delay when changing VPN servers.

features.name: Disable telemetry
features.description: Blocks all telemetry, analytics, and observability data collection.

features.name: Hide feed ads
features.description: Collapses sponsored zinstant items in the Nhật ký feed to zero height.

features.name: Hide message ads
features.description: Hides the Zinstant ad row in the Messages (Tin nhắn) tab and skips loading its content.

features.name: Skip feed ads binding
features.description: Prevents sponsored feed items from loading their zinstant bundle and reporting impressions. Disable this one first if the feed misbehaves.

features.name: Filter feed ads before parsing
features.description: Drops sponsored items from the Nhật ký feed at the JSON parse layer, before any view is created. Experimental — turn this off first if posts go missing from your feed.

features.name: Hide story ads
features.description: Hides sponsored items in the story viewer. Verify the story tray still advances before relying on this.

features.name: Hide Zalo Video ads
features.description: Hides ad containers, native ad layouts and outstream ads in Zalo Video.

features.name: Disable sponsored placements
features.description: Turns off Zalo's Story and Community ad slots at their server config flags, so sponsored items are never inserted (no blank gaps, no impressions). Promotions sent as Official Account messages are not affected.

features.name: Block Adtima ad requests
features.description: Stops the bundled Adtima SDK from fetching ad creatives (api.adtimaserver.vn/mobad/*) for native, bundle, banner, interstitial and rewarded placements.

features.name: Block Adtima video ad requests
features.description: Also blocks pre-roll, mid-roll and audio ad requests. May delay or stall playback if Zalo waits for an ad result — turn this off first if video stops starting.

features.name: Disable ads tracking
features.description: Blocks Adtima impression/click reporting and the Zalo ads tracking receiver.

features.name: Disable Adtima offline ads and tracking
features.description: Keeps Adtima's offline (pre-cached) ad window closed and stops its active-view / impression tracking hits.

features.name: Opt out of Adtima ad tracking
features.description: Tells the bundled Adtima SDK that ad tracking is limited and skips its Google advertising-ID lookup. Complements the Adtima request blocks.

features.name: Remove Google ad networks from Adtima
features.description: Always drops AdMob, Google Ad Manager and IMA from Adtima's mediation list, whatever the server config says.

features.name: Disable Crashlytics crash reporting
features.description: Stops Firebase Crashlytics from collecting and uploading Zalo crash reports, logs, custom keys and your user ID. Zalo itself is unaffected.

features.name: Disable analytics database
features.description: Stops Zalo from recording events, screens, sessions and views in its analytics database, so there is nothing for it to upload.

features.name: Disable Firebase Analytics
features.description: Turns off Google/Firebase Analytics (measurement) inside Zalo and blocks its connection to the Google Play services measurement service. Push notifications are unaffected.

features.name: Disable Advertising ID
features.description: Gives Zalo and its ad/analytics SDKs an all-zero advertising ID with ad tracking limited, instead of your real Google advertising ID.

features.name: Auto-record call audio
features.description: Records Zalo one-to-one voice/video call audio to Recordings/Zalo Call Recordings as M4A. Runs the native ZRTC recorder. Default off. Recording calls may require the consent of all parties where you live — check local law before enabling.

features.name: Block seen status
features.description: Hides your read receipts ("Đã xem") while still sending delivered status, so you keep receiving other people's receipts. Blocks the outbound seen ack at the socket transport (covers direct chats and the group/batch SendSeenManager) with the message repository as a fallback.

features.name: Block typing status
features.description: Stops sending the "Đang nhập" (typing) indicator in individual and group chats. Blocks the typing packet at the socket transport, with the message repository wrapper as a fallback.

features.name: Prefer original photo quality
features.description: Sends photos in Zalo's existing Original quality by default, including photos shared in from other apps, and skips the client-side Z Cloud entitlement check. Photos taken with the in-app Zalo camera stay HD. Server upload limits, account restrictions and video quality are unchanged.

features.name: Keep expired media accessible
features.description: Keeps large chat files that are still stored on the device usable after Zalo marks them expired, instead of showing the Z Cloud / expired screen. It does not restore missing files or bypass server download limits.

features.name: Always allow Google Drive photo backup
features.description: Keeps the "Photos – backed up on Google Drive" option available even after your old backup was deleted. Zalo otherwise only offers it to accounts whose existing backup already used Drive.

features.name: Remove background playback restrictions
features.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

features.name: Sanitize sharing links
features.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

features.name: Hide ads
features.description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

features.name: SponsorBlock
features.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

features.name: Copy video link
features.description: Adds options to display buttons in the video player to copy video links.

features.name: Downloads
features.description: Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button.

features.name: Hide Shorts components
features.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.

features.name: Disable Shorts resuming on startup
features.description: Adds an option to disable Shorts from resuming on app startup when Shorts were last being watched.

features.name: Navigation bar
features.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.

features.name: Swipe controls
features.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

features.name: Video quality
features.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

features.name: Hide layout components
features.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

features.name: Hide video action buttons
features.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

features.name: Playback speed
features.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

features.name: Auto captions
features.description: Adds an option to disable captions from being automatically enabled.

features.name: Enable debugging
features.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

features.name: Force original audio
features.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

features.name: Disable video codecs
features.description: Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 codecs.

features.name: Alternative thumbnails
features.description: Adds options to replace video thumbnails using the DeArrow API or image captures from the video.

features.name: Bypass image region restrictions
features.description: Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images and can fix missing images that are blocked in some countries.

features.name: Change start page
features.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

features.name: Remove background playback restrictions
features.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

features.name: Hide upgrade button
features.description: Hides the upgrade tab from the pivot bar.

features.name: Hide ads
features.description: Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

features.name: Enable exclusive audio playback
features.description: Enables the option to play audio without video.

features.name: Enable debugging
features.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

features.name: Sanitize sharing links
features.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

features.name: Hide ads
features.description: Adds options to hide ads.

features.name: Sanitize sharing links
features.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

features.name: Start as guest
features.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

features.name: Hide ads
features.description: Hides injected ads, sponsored content, paid partnership, and Reels/Stories ads.

features.name: Sanitize tracking links
features.description: Removes tracking parameters from Instagram links when copying.

features.name: Block ads and analytics
features.description: Blocks ads and analytics network requests for Feed, Reels, Stories, and Explore.

features.name: Ghost interceptor
features.description: Blocks ghost mode network requests via TigonServiceLayer (screenshot, view once, story seen).

features.name: Ghost screenshot
features.description: Blocks screenshot notification from being sent to the other party.

features.name: Ghost seen state
features.description: Blocks DM read receipts from being sent. Chats you open still show as read on your phone.

features.name: Ghost typing status
features.description: Blocks typing indicator from being sent to the other party.

features.name: Ghost view story
features.description: Prevents story seen notifications from being sent to the uploader.

features.name: Ghost ephemeral keep
features.description: Prevents vanish/ephemeral (disappearing) messages from being deleted locally.

features.name: Ghost permanent view
features.description: Makes unexpired view-once and replayable media permanently accessible.

features.name: View live anonymously
features.description: Prevents Instagram from knowing you viewed a live stream by blocking the heartbeat/viewer-count endpoint.

features.name: Screenshot permission
features.description: Allows screenshots in DMs, stories, and reels by removing FLAG_SECURE.

features.name: Save deleted messages
features.description: Keeps direct messages visible after the person who sent them unsends. Blocks Instagram from dropping the message from the conversation and from deleting it locally. Unsending your own messages still works.

features.name: Download reels
features.description: Adds a Download entry to the reel overflow menu. Reels whose video and audio arrive as separate streams are merged before saving.

features.name: Download posts
features.description: Adds a Download entry to the three-dots menu on a post. Carousels open a sheet to save the current slide or every slide at once.

features.name: Download stories
features.description: Adds a download button to the story viewer. A story with music offers the video and the still photo separately, since the photo has no soundtrack to strip.

features.name: Download profile pictures
features.description: Adds a Download entry when a profile picture is opened, saving the full-resolution image rather than the cropped thumbnail.

features.name: Save instants
features.description: Long-press a received instant (quicksnap) in a direct message to save it.

features.name: Upload instants from gallery
features.description: Adds a chip to the instant camera that sends a picture from the gallery instead of one taken right then.

features.name: Copy media link
features.description: Adds a Copy link entry beside Download in the post and reel menus, which copies the direct CDN URL of the media.

features.name: Sort downloads into username folders
features.description: Saves each file into a sub-folder named after the account it came from, instead of dropping everything into one folder.

features.name: Add a timestamp to download filenames
features.description: Appends the date and time to every saved filename, so saving the same post twice keeps both copies.

features.name: Hide ads
features.description: Hides injected ads, sponsored content, and paid partnership posts in Threads feed.

features.name: Block ads and analytics
features.description: Blocks ads and analytics network requests.

features.name: Sanitize tracking links
features.description: Removes tracking parameters from Threads links when copying.

features.name: Unlock subscription features
features.description: Unlocks "Routes", "Matched Runs" and "Segment Efforts".

features.name: Enable Peak membership
features.description: Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.

features.name: Enable SoundCloud Go+
features.description: Enables SoundCloud Go+ premium features, offline listening, HQ audio, and disables audio/visual ads.

features.name: Disable analytics
features.description: Disables SoundCloud's analytics.

features.name: Disable consent popup
features.description: Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup and collapses banner views.

features.name: Hide Facebook ads
features.description: Removes sponsored feed stories, Reels ads, game ads, and banner ads.

features.name: Hide in-stream ad breaks
features.description: Removes mid-roll ad breaks and the docked sponsored card from videos and live replays.

features.name: Hide profile timeline ads
features.description: Removes sponsored posts from profile pages by checking for an advertisement's tracking id. Posts without one are left alone.

features.name: Hide search ads
features.description: Removes sponsored results from Facebook search, identified by the result's own advertisement type. Organic results are left untouched.

features.name: Spoof ad-free session
features.description: Makes Facebook believe an ad-free session is active, so the server stops sending sponsored content (including sponsored Stories tray circles).

features.name: Aggressive banner & ad-break blocking
features.description: Broad upstream hooks: ad-break state machine and banner-ad boolean sweep. May break some screens; off by default.

features.name: View stories without marking seen
features.description: Stops the story viewer from reporting stories as seen, so the owner does not see you in the viewer list.

features.name: Allow screenshots & recording
features.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE so screenshots and screen recordings work everywhere in Facebook.

features.name: Block screenshot detection
features.description: Stops Facebook from detecting screenshots and screen recordings.

features.name: Unwrap l.php redirect links
features.description: Opens the real destination of Facebook's l.php redirect links, without fbclid tracking.

features.name: Filter Discover ads
features.description: Filters promoted ad cards from the Google Discover feed.

features.name: Remove ads
features.description: Removes promoted posts, trends and Google ads.

features.name: Hide recommendation items
features.description: Hides recommendation items such as "Who to follow" and "Today's news" in timeline, search, and replies.

features.name: No shortened URL
features.description: Gets rid of t.co short urls by showing the expanded URL instead.

features.name: Remove premium upsell
features.description: Removes premium upsells.

features.name: Unlock downloads
features.description: Unlocks media downloads and offline video saving in the X app.

features.name: Force enable translate
features.description: Get translate option for all posts.

features.name: Show poll results
features.description: Adds an option to show poll results without voting.

features.name: Hide Banner
features.description: Hides the "new posts" banner shown at the top of the timeline.

features.name: Disable blur effects
features.description: Disables Haze blur in the Compose UI of the new X app, while preserving the configured fallback tint and scrim effects. Has no effect on the older X UI.

features.name: Hide ads
features.description: Removes the sponsored rows Gmail renders between conversations.

features.name: Hide ads
features.description: Filters sponsored InboxAdsItem rows from Messenger inbox lists.

features.name: Disable read receipts
features.description: Stops outgoing read dispatch while retaining the local inbox update and notification handling.

features.name: Disable typing status
features.description: Forces outgoing typing state to stopped without cancelling the mailbox callback.

features.name: Remove feed ads
features.description: Removes sponsored videos from the For You, Following, Friends and profile feeds, mid-roll and profile pager ads, search result ads and the scroll lock of short-drama ads, including ads inserted after the feed was loaded and the cold-start cache.

features.name: Skip splash ads
features.description: Skips the full-screen splash and TopView ads shown when TikTok opens or returns from the background, and stops TikTok downloading them.

features.name: Hide TikTok Shop ads
features.description: Hides the TikTok Shop product cards (price, voucher, "Not interested" and "Claim" buttons) inserted into the For You feed. Independent of Remove feed ads, which only removes sponsored videos.

features.name: Hide paid partnerships
features.description: Also hides creator posts labelled "Paid partnership" (branded content), "Creator earns commission" and location affiliate posts. Your own posts are kept.

features.name: Hide promoted-music videos
features.description: Also hides videos flagged by TikTok as using a paid promoted sound. May hide some organic creator videos.

features.name: Disable screen capture detection
features.description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

features.name: Allow screenshots everywhere
features.description: Takes FLAG_SECURE off every TikTok window so screenshots and screen recordings work on protected screens too (paid LIVE, payment and verification pages, ...), and lifts the Circle to Search block on the feed.

features.name: Disable telemetry
features.description: Stops ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, Firebase screen reports and the Npth/MonitorCrash crash reporters. The For You feed then no longer learns from what you watch.

features.name: Ghost mode
features.description: Stops TikTok from reporting what you look at: story views, profile visits and the typing indicator. Your online status is unchanged.

features.name: Sanitize sharing links
features.description: Removes the tracking parameters (utm_*, share_*, u_code, _r, _t, ...) from TikTok links before they are shared or copied.

features.name: Open external links in browser
features.description: Opens website links from profiles and story link stickers in your phone's browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser.

features.name: Disable login requirement
features.description: Removes TikTok's forced login screen so the feed stays usable while signed out.

features.name: Fix Google login
features.description: Forces TikTok's web-based Google sign-in. Only needed when the APK was re-signed (LSPatch or a repackaged build), where Play Services rejects the native flow.

features.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
features.description: Skips browsing puzzle dialogs and reports them as closed. Account verification (SMS, e-mail, password, identity) and login flows are left alone. The action that triggered the puzzle will usually fail instead.

features.name: Remove download watermark
features.description: Saves videos and photos without the TikTok watermark.

features.name: Allow restricted downloads
features.description: Shows and enables "Save video" (and save photo / GIF / Live Photo) even when the creator turned downloads off, and keeps the sound in saved videos.
